title: Vaulted White Kitchen
blurb: A vaulted great room opened up around a long white island, with glass-front uppers, a paneled range hood, and leather stools pulled up to the quartz. Filmed in a single visit the week of final walkthrough.
details: Paneled range hood and glass-front uppers
Quartz waterfall island with seating for five
Pendants centered over the island run

title: Navy Kitchen Remodel
blurb: Navy base cabinets under white uppers, a blue glazed-tile backsplash, and brass pulls, with a slide-in gas range as the centerpiece. Photographed and filmed the same morning.
details: Navy base cabinets with brass hardware
Slide-in gas range with stainless hood

title: White Shaker Kitchen
blurb: A galley kitchen rebuilt with white shaker cabinets, a marble-look backsplash, under-cabinet lighting, and a skylight that makes the whole run of counter glow by mid-morning.
details: Skylight over the main counter run

title: Teal Double Vanity Bath
blurb: A primary bath with a teal double vanity, brass fixtures, oval mirrors, and a frameless glass shower. Small room, big reveal, and a reel that stops the scroll.
details: Teal double vanity with brass pulls

title: Freestanding Tub Bath
blurb: A freestanding soaking tub under a window, a brass floor-mount filler, and a patterned diamond tile wall. Afternoon light does half the work in this one.

title: Marble Tub and Shower
blurb: Book-matched green marble panels wrap the tub and shower, with a deep soaking tub, wood-look plank floor, and a dark vanity with a lit mirror.
details: Backlit mirror over a dark vanity

title: Dark Cabinet Kitchen
blurb: Espresso cabinets, a white quartz island with a pro-style cooktop, a stainless farmhouse sink, and a glass-canopy hood over the range wall.

title: Second-Story Addition
blurb: A full second story framed over a brick ranch. Filmed during the build and again at dusk, so the before, the during, and the finish all live in one project film.
details: Full second-story framing over existing brick

title: Black and Brass Bath
blurb: Black doors, a white double vanity with brushed brass faucets, a brass chandelier, and a book-matched marble shower with a built-in niche. Filmed in afternoon light, the week of final walkthrough.
details: Brushed brass widespread faucets on a white vanity
Book-matched marble shower with a niche

title: Two-Story Custom Home
blurb: A two-story custom home filmed room by room: the foyer under the chandelier, the fireplace and stair, the kitchen with the range wall, the primary bedroom, and the bath with the patterned-tile tub. One visit, one film, every room.
details: Two-story foyer with chandelier and stair
White kitchen with pro range and hood

title: Whole-Home Remodel
blurb: A main floor opened up end to end: coffered ceiling over the great room, a white kitchen with a long peninsula and sliding doors to the yard, and a double vanity bath with lit mirrors. Filmed empty, the day before move-in.
details: Coffered ceiling across the great room
White kitchen with peninsula and sliding doors
